name: The first point

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: Haramad explains that an ancient draenei legend speaks of a crystal with power great enough to be called godlike. He fears the Burning Legion may uncover it first, and gives the surveying equipment a purpose at last: find the first triangulation point. The quest sends the seeker to report to Dealer Hazzin, one of the prince’s agents. The power is the legend as Haramad relays it; the urgency is his stated concern. Neither makes the crystal’s full history certain.
